commits.message:
RawHits. Reshuffling.
- Reshuffling:
+ "coalescedHs" and Xreference maps made data members.
+ "nChannels" in geometry.
+ "fill(Sim|Rec|Raw)Hit" methods.
+ Systematically "idet" and index into hit array as args.
+ "requirement...OK" methods.
+ Hijack SimTrackerHitData's quality for storing evaluation of requirements.
 Set "quality" and systematise "cellID" and "pathLength" members of "coalescedHs".
+ "getEDBinning" method.
+ Print evaluation of # of eDep's above threshold.
- RawHits:
+ "rawBranches" and "raws" hit array.
+ RawHs "chN, ADC, TDC" histos.
+ "raw2coas" map.
Move geometry to "./src/geometry.C".

Edges. Debugging printout. "DrawSimHit". Modularisation.
- Edges:
+ Fix edge crossing in "cExtension".
+ New "requireOffEdge"
++ As opposed to "requireOffBorder" (which is former "requireOffEdge" renamed).
++ Making use of overloaded "(c|b)Extension".
++ Which implies filling momentum and "pathLength" of coalesced SimTrackerHits.
+ => Perfect Dirac for CyMBaL's "Rr" and Outer's "Rcdphi".
- Debugging printouts:
+ Use (more often) local coordinates.
+ More unconditional details.
- DrawSimHit: Fix Outer's case.
- Modularisation: "getCyMBaLRadius".

Clean "LayerModule" class definition.
(Comment in commit #edca344 about Ur and Vr residuals turns out to be wrong).

LayerModule. Histos. Geometry. Drawing. Evaluation not fully OK.
- LayerModule:
+ Control Quality(=1|2) also for detectors w/ #modules>64.
+ LayerModule selection, input w/ "AddRequiredLayerModules".
+ TODO: move methods outside "LayerModule" class definition.
- Histos:
+ Binning of R residuals (or Z for ECTs) from geometry's "volumeThicknesses".
++ And some empirical adjustments.
+ R residuals for everybody.
- Geometry:
+ "volumeThicknesses". Fix "radii" for "Si".
- Drawing: Minimum set =0.5 for Logy scale.
- Evaluation:
+ Stray residuals, while requiring PDG and Quality(=2) and even OffEdge.
+ Stray residuals also for ECTs (very few) and Vertex.
+ Outer Integral of Ur and Vr residuals slightly lower than previous.
Update README.md
README: fix images.
Documenation. Cosmetics.

Bug fix in "extend". ECTs. Geometry. xyr. "SetNSensitiveSurface". Style. README.
- "extend": fix ensures that position of returned SimHit is always defined,
 even when SUBVOLUME is neither 0x3 nor 0x4.
- ECTs:
+ "Barrels" member data.
+ Specific "module" determination.
- Geometry:
+ "initGeometry": "idet" input arg. (not that useful so far...).
+ "ZAbscissae".
+ Histo binning fully derived from geometry.
- xyr:
+ CyMBaL: R in R*phi is now fixed radius, instead of hit radius.
+ Outer: Not understood under-/over-flows, worked around by adding a margin to
 the axis range (and debugging "DEBUG_xyrOUTLIERS" cpp, disabled by default).
- "SetNSensitiveSurface": # of surfaces can only be =1 or =5.
- Style: Pad left and bottom margin.
Fix bug preventing "BookHistos" from processing non-MPGDs.

Outlier residuals. Cylinder extension. Edge in phi. Fix gains. Debug control. README.
- Outlier residuals:
+ Distinguish between off and on edge.
+ Fix onEdge for phi.
- Cylinder extension: extrapolation may fail to reach lower wall.
- Edge in phi: Exclude phi+pi solution.

More modularity.
- "getMCParticle", "getrec2coas".

Extend hit. Local->global. Tolerance. Edge. Geometry. Cleaning.
- Extend:
+ Align handling of Outer on that of CyMBaL ("bExtension").
- Local->global: Fix "l2gOuter".
- Tolerance: Basic tolerance tightened: 0.075 -> 0.025... but "toleranceFactor(P)".
- Edge:
+ Outliers (in warning messages): take "isOnEdge" into account.
+ "isOnEdge","getResCut","requireOffEdge"
- Geometry: Add "pitches", "resolutions".
- Cleaning:
+ Cancel "Histos::RA", "Resids::R,D".
+ Transparent debugging.

eDep histos. Debugging printout.
- eDep histos: have a bin edge @ threshold.

Histos: "eDep", "xyr", cosmetics.
+ "eDep": added to simHs and recHs (latter rescaled by geometry::gain).
+ Remove TProfile2D "xyr" (it disrupts the arrays of "resHs").
+ Geometry: extended use.
+ PaveStats: optStat from arg. to "SetPaveText".
+ TPad w/ Logx/y.
+ Axes: title offset increased to make for labels when Logx.

Histos. Geometry. "coalesce"
- Histos:
+ dphi -> Rdphi
+ Geometry: extended use in defining binning
- "coalesce":
+ SUBVOLUMES 0x3|0x4, yet not 0x3&0x4: get position from single subHit "extended".

Global->Local. 2D histos. Modularisation.
=> # of Sim entries = # of Rec-entries. No over/underflow for residuals.
- 2D histos:
+ Reshuffle (x,y) local: remove per zone subdivision, geometry-based binning.
+ TProfile2D of residuals for Outer.
- Modularisation: "isMPGD", "setAxes", "getxyArgs".
- Cleaning: remove debugging leftovers, the "zone" investigation.

- Extrapolate: Cut on distance made dependent upon P (and SUBVOLUMES).
 => It's relaxed for all P, more so for small P (< tens of MeV),
  and for thin SUBVOLUMES.
- "checkTraversing": Cut on "pathDepth" 200 -> 75 um.

Extending of Outer. "bDrawHit". Geometry.
- Outer:
+ Add a "checkTraversing" to the extending Outer hit, but...
...if extension granted, no block dedicated to Outer yet in "extendHit".
+ Global -> Local: now "g2lOuter" member method,
++ returning rotation angle upon option,
++ returning local "Z".
- "DrawSimHit": add "bDrawHit", next to a "cDrawHit" for Outer.
- Geometry:
+ Method "initGeometry".
+ More appropriate naming of some data members.

Coalesce. DrawSimHit. Debugging.
- Coalesce:
+ Set 0x7-coalesced position = 1/2sum of hits extrapolated by 1/2-pathLength.
- DrawSimHit: colouring.
- Debugging: Improved messages, extended to Outer.

Hit extension. Global <-> Local. DrawSimHit. Geometry.
- Hit extension:
+ Reshuffling, introducing member method "extendHit".
+ Special case of hit position outside SUBVOLUME 0x4.
- Global <-> Local:
+ Include Z coord.
+ "getReducedCyMBaL" -> "g2lCyMBal".
+ Made a member method.
+ New counterpart: "l2gCyMBal".
- "DrawSimHit".
- Geometry: attempt at collecting it as a set of data members.

"checkTraversing". "extend". SimTrackerHit::eDep. MCPARTICLE...
- "checkTraversing":
+ Conditions "extrapolate", if "requireTraversing" data member is set.
+ Conditions "extend", systematically.
+ Rescue cases where traversing is only to one side.
- "extend": (if "checkTraversing" fulfilled) made to depend upon direction.
- Geometry block: used by rescue (and histo booking).
- MCPARTICLE:
+ "Hits_MCParticle" upgraded to "Hits_particle" (unless MCPARTICLE defined).
- Debugging:
+ Header is now ("Evt #<evtNum>" det<idet>").
+ Also printed when singleton hit => No call to "samePMO".
- Include not "edm4hep/TrackerHitData.h".

Fix Association. Event control: module selection. Verbosity. Fix Vertex/Si.
- Association:
+ "rec2coas" was badly built.
+ "rec2sims" renamed "rec2coas".
- Event control:
+ Modularity.
+ "evtToDebug".
+ Cancel "requireNHits".
- Module selection:
+ "requireQuality>1": Keep track of all modules in "modPats" data member.
+ "requiresModules" = list of 0x1<<module's.
- Vertex/Si: bypass coalescing/extending

Strip/NoStrip. Binning. Ndivisions policy.
- Strip/NoStrip:
+ Swicth in ctor => Sets data member "stripMode".
+ Member method "parseStrip".
Merge branch 'master' of github.com:ybedfer/recoEvents

UV segmentation (OK w/in <=1.6 µm). "Outer" in "MPGDs" array. Upgrade gcc.
- Determine "Xr,Yr" and "Ur,Vr" in "getReducedOuter".
- Histo "Ur,Vr" in "recHs" and "resHs".
- Update "parseCellID".
